decisions.choice: a heading: "what came as the word of the LORD"
decisions.reason: The verse opens with "which", an unusual way to begin. It is a heading for what follows, a form Jeremiah uses again for some later oracles (46:1; 47:1; 49:34). It introduces the poems and dialogue of 14:2-15:9, which grow out of a time of drought.

decisions.choice: the droughts: times when the rain failed
decisions.reason: The noun means a lack of rain, a dry spell (17:8). It is plural here, which may point to repeated droughts or to one drought so long and severe that it is spoken of as many. "The matters of" means the events or circumstances of the drought; verses 2-6 describe them.

decisions.choice: That which came [as] the word of the LORD ... / The word of the LORD that came ... / This is the message the LORD gave Jeremiah ...
decisions.reason: The heading follows the wording settled for Jeremiah's formula "the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD", adjusted for this verse's different order. Readable says "message" as it does in that formula.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of this chapter.
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic; pronouns for God are written plainly.

decisions.choice: "... का जो वचन ... यिर्मयाह के पास पहुँचा" (L, B); "... ने यिर्मयाह को ... यह संदेश दिया" (R)
decisions.reason: The heading uses the same wording as 11:1 and the note's formula for the word of the LORD coming to the prophet, fitted to this verse's order; "सूखा" is the everyday word for a drought.

decisions.choice: "о засухах", plural
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has the plural, the droughts, times when the rain failed; Russian keeps it at every level, as the English does.

decisions.choice: The heading 'asher hayah devar-YHWH 'el-Yirmeyahu follows the JER formula: "エレミヤに臨んだ{D}の言葉" (L, B), "{D}は、エレミヤに次のように語られました" (R, narrator です・ます with the light respect form); habbatsarot "干ばつ" (Japanese leaves the plural unmarked).
decisions.reason: JEREMIAH CONVENTIONS formulas (7:1, 11:1).

records.literal_gloss: Mourns Judah, and her gates languish; they are dark to the ground, and [the] cry of Jerusalem has gone up.

en.L: Judah mourns, \q and her gates languish; they are dark [in mourning] to the ground, \q and the cry of Jerusalem has gone up.
en.B: Judah mourns, \q her gates droop and fail; her people sit on the ground in black, \q and the cry of Jerusalem rises.
en.R: The people of Judah are in mourning. \q Their towns are wasting away; people sit on the ground in clothes of grief. \q A loud cry goes up from Jerusalem.

es.L: Judá está de luto, \q y sus puertas desfallecen; se enlutan hasta el suelo, \q y sube el clamor de Jerusalén.
es.B: Judá está de luto, \q sus puertas decaen y desfallecen; su gente se sienta en el suelo vestida de negro, \q y se eleva el clamor de Jerusalén.
es.R: La gente de Judá está de luto. \q Sus ciudades se consumen; la gente se sienta en el suelo con ropa de duelo. \q Un fuerte grito sube desde Jerusalén.

fr.L: Juda est en deuil, \q et ses portes dépérissent ; elles sont sombres [de deuil] jusqu’à terre, \q et le cri de Jérusalem est monté.
fr.B: Juda est en deuil, \q ses portes s’affaissent ; ses habitants sont assis par terre, vêtus de noir, \q et le cri de Jérusalem s’élève.
fr.R: Le peuple de Juda est en deuil. \q Ses villes dépérissent ; les gens sont assis par terre, en habits de deuil. \q Un grand cri monte de Jérusalem.

sw.L: Yuda anaomboleza, \q na malango yake yanadhoofika; yamekaa gizani [kwa maombolezo] hadi chini, \q na kilio cha Yerusalemu kimepanda juu.
sw.B: Yuda anaomboleza, \q malango yake yanalegea na kuzimia; watu wake wameketi chini wamevaa nguo nyeusi, \q na kilio cha Yerusalemu kinapanda juu.
sw.R: Watu wa Yuda wanaomboleza. \q Miji yao inadhoofika; watu wameketi chini wamevaa nguo za huzuni. \q Kilio kikuu kinapanda kutoka Yerusalemu.

vi.L: Giu-đa than khóc, \q các cổng thành nó mòn mỏi; chúng [mặc tang] tối sầm sát đất, \q và tiếng kêu la của Giê-ru-sa-lem đã vang lên.
vi.B: Giu-đa than khóc, \q các cổng thành rũ rượi tiêu điều; dân chúng mặc đồ đen ngồi bệt dưới đất, \q và tiếng kêu la của Giê-ru-sa-lem vang lên.

ko.L: 유다가 슬퍼하고 \q 그 성문들이 시들며, 땅바닥에 [엎드려] 검게 되었다. \q 예루살렘의 부르짖음이 올라간다.
ko.B: 유다가 슬퍼하고 \q 그 성문들이 기운을 잃었다. 백성은 검은 옷을 입고 땅바닥에 앉아 있고, \q 예루살렘의 부르짖음이 하늘로 올라간다.
ko.R: 유다 백성이 슬픔에 잠겨 있다. \q 그들의 성읍들은 시들어 간다. 사람들은 슬픔의 옷을 입고 땅바닥에 앉아 있다. \q 예루살렘에서 큰 울부짖음이 올라간다.

pt.L: Judá está de luto, \q e as suas portas definham; estão escuras [de luto] até o chão, \q e o clamor de Jerusalém subiu.
pt.B: Judá está de luto, \q as suas portas murcham e desfalecem; o seu povo se senta no chão vestido de preto, \q e o clamor de Jerusalém sobe.
pt.R: O povo de Judá está de luto. \q As suas cidades estão se acabando; as pessoas se sentam no chão com roupas de luto. \q Um grande grito sobe de Jerusalém.

am.L: ይሁዳ ታለቅሳለች፤ \q በሮቿም ዝለዋል፤ እስከ ምድር ድረስ [በሐዘን] ጠቁረዋል፤ \q የኢየሩሳሌምም ጩኸት ወጥቷል።
am.B: ይሁዳ ታለቅሳለች፤ \q በሮቿ ተዳክመዋል፤ ሕዝቧ ጥቁር ለብሰው በመሬት ላይ ተቀምጠዋል፤ \q የኢየሩሳሌምም ጩኸት ወደ ላይ ይወጣል።
am.R: የይሁዳ ሕዝብ በሐዘን ላይ ናቸው። \q ከተሞቻቸው እየደከሙ ነው፤ ሰዎች የሐዘን ልብስ ለብሰው መሬት ላይ ተቀምጠዋል። \q ከኢየሩሳሌም ታላቅ ጩኸት ይሰማል።

hi.L: यहूदा विलाप करता है, \q और उसके फाटक मुरझा गए हैं; वे भूमि तक [शोक में] काले हैं, \q और यरूशलेम की चिल्लाहट ऊपर उठी है।
hi.B: यहूदा विलाप करता है, \q उसके फाटक ढीले पड़कर मुरझा रहे हैं; उसके लोग काले वस्त्र पहने भूमि पर बैठे हैं, \q और यरूशलेम की चिल्लाहट ऊपर उठती है।
hi.R: यहूदा के लोग शोक मना रहे हैं। \q उनके नगर उजड़ते जा रहे हैं; लोग शोक के वस्त्र पहने भूमि पर बैठे हैं। \q यरूशलेम से ज़ोर की चिल्लाहट उठ रही है।

ru.L: Сетует Иуда, \q и ворота его изнемогают; они почернели [от скорби] до земли, \q и вопль Иерусалима поднялся.
ru.B: Иуда скорбит, \q его ворота поникли и изнемогли; его люди сидят на земле в чёрном, \q и поднимается вопль Иерусалима.
ru.R: Народ Иуды в трауре. \q Его города угасают; люди сидят на земле в одежде скорби. \q Из Иерусалима поднимается громкий крик.

ja.L: ユダは喪に服し、 \q その門は衰え果て、[喪の黒をまとって]地に伏し、 \q エルサレムの叫びが立ち上った。
ja.B: ユダは喪に服し、 \q その門はしおれて衰え、人々は黒い喪服で地に座り込む。 \q エルサレムの叫びが立ち上る。
ja.R: ユダの人々は嘆き悲しんでいる。 \q 町々は衰え、人々は喪服を着て地面に座り込んでいる。 \q エルサレムから大きな叫び声が上がる。

uk.L: Юдея в жалобі, \q і її брами знемагають; вони почорніли [в жалобі] до землі, \q і крик Єрусалима піднявся.
uk.B: Юдея в жалобі, \q її брами никнуть і знемагають; її люди сидять на землі в чорному, \q і здіймається крик Єрусалима.
uk.R: Народ Юдеї в жалобі. \q Їхні міста марніють; люди сидять на землі в жалобному одязі. \q Гучний крик здіймається з Єрусалима.

decisions.choice: her gates languish: the towns and the people who gather at their gates waste away
decisions.reason: The gate was the busy public place of a town, where people met, traded and held court. When its gates "languish" (the verb is used of plants that wither, Isaiah 24:7; Joel 1:10, 12), the whole life of the town is drying up (compare Isaiah 3:26, where Zion's gates mourn).

decisions.choice: dark to the ground: in dark mourning clothes, bowed down or sitting on the ground
decisions.reason: The verb means to be dark or dirty, and is used of mourners in dark, unwashed clothes (Psalms 35:14; 38:7; Job 30:28). "To the ground" adds the picture of mourners bowed low or sitting in the dust (Lamentations 2:10).

decisions.choice: cry: a loud scream of distress
decisions.reason: The word is a shrill outcry of people in trouble or grief (46:12; Isaiah 24:11). It "goes up" as if rising to heaven for help.

decisions.choice: her people sit on the ground in black / people sit on the ground in clothes of grief
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only that "they" are dark to the ground. Balanced and Readable name the people as the ones mourning and explain the darkness as mourning clothes (meaning decision m2). Readable says "towns" for the gates (m1).

decisions.choice: "ворота его"
decisions.reason: Judah is feminine in the Hebrew ("her gates"), but Иуда is masculine in Russian, so the pronoun follows Russian grammar.

decisions.choice: she'areiha 'umlalu "その門は衰え果て" (L), "その門はしおれて衰え" (B), "町々は衰え" (R); qoderu la'arets "[喪の黒をまとって]地に伏し" (L), "黒い喪服で地に座り込む" (B, R), as m1-m2 and the English.
decisions.reason: The gate stands for the town and its people (m1); dark is the colour of mourning (m2).

source.text: וְאַדִּ֣רֵיהֶ֔ם שָׁלְח֥וּ צְעִירֵיהֶ֖ם לַמָּ֑יִם בָּ֣אוּ עַל־גֵּבִ֞ים לֹא־מָ֣צְאוּ מַ֗יִם שָׁ֤בוּ כְלֵיהֶם֙ רֵיקָ֔ם בֹּ֥שׁוּ וְהָכְלְמ֖וּ וְחָפ֥וּ רֹאשָֽׁם׃

records.literal_gloss: And their nobles have sent their young ones for water; they have come to cisterns, not have they found water, they have returned [with] their vessels empty; they are ashamed and humiliated, and have covered their head.

en.L: And their nobles send their young ones for water; \q they come to [the] cisterns, they find no water, they return [with] their vessels empty; \q they are ashamed and humiliated, and they cover their heads.
en.B: Their nobles send their young servants to fetch water; \q they reach the cisterns and there is no water; their vessels come back empty. \q They are ashamed and disgraced, and they cover their heads.
en.R: The leaders send their servants to get water. \q The servants go to the water pits, but there is no water. They come back with empty jars. \q They feel ashamed and disgraced, and they cover their heads.

es.L: Y sus nobles envían a sus muchachos por agua; \q llegan a las cisternas, no hallan agua, vuelven [con] sus vasijas vacías; \q se avergüenzan y se humillan, y cubren sus cabezas.
es.B: Sus nobles envían a sus criados a buscar agua; \q llegan a las cisternas y no hay agua; sus vasijas vuelven vacías. \q Están avergonzados y humillados, y se cubren la cabeza.
es.R: Los jefes mandan a sus sirvientes a buscar agua. \q Los sirvientes van a los pozos, pero no hay agua. Vuelven con los cántaros vacíos. \q Se sienten avergonzados y humillados, y se cubren la cabeza.

fr.L: Et leurs nobles envoient leurs jeunes gens chercher de l’eau ; \q ils viennent aux citernes, ils ne trouvent pas d’eau, ils reviennent [avec] leurs vases vides ; \q ils sont honteux et confus, et ils se couvrent la tête.
fr.B: Les nobles envoient leurs jeunes serviteurs chercher de l’eau ; \q ils arrivent aux citernes, et il n’y a pas d’eau ; ils rapportent leurs vases vides. \q Ils sont honteux et humiliés, et ils se couvrent la tête.
fr.R: Les chefs envoient leurs serviteurs chercher de l’eau. \q Les serviteurs vont aux réservoirs, mais il n’y a pas d’eau. Ils reviennent avec des jarres vides. \q Ils ont honte et se sentent humiliés, et ils se couvrent la tête.

sw.L: Na wakuu wao wanawatuma wadogo wao kuteka maji; \q wanafika kwenye visima, hawapati maji, wanarudi [na] vyombo vyao vitupu; \q wanaona haya na kufedheheka, nao wanajifunika vichwa vyao.
sw.B: Wakuu wao wanawatuma watumishi wao vijana kwenda kuteka maji; \q wanafika visimani lakini hakuna maji; vyombo vyao vinarudi vitupu. \q Wanaona aibu na kufedheheka, nao wanajifunika vichwa.
sw.R: Viongozi wanawatuma watumishi wao kwenda kuchota maji. \q Watumishi wanakwenda kwenye mashimo ya maji, lakini hakuna maji. Wanarudi na mitungi mitupu. \q Wanaona aibu na kufedheheka, nao wanajifunika vichwa.

vi.L: Các nhà quyền quý sai những kẻ nhỏ của mình đi lấy nước; \q chúng đến các hồ chứa, chẳng tìm thấy nước, chúng trở về [với] bình không; \q chúng hổ thẹn và nhục nhã, và chúng trùm đầu lại.
vi.B: Các nhà quyền quý sai đầy tớ đi lấy nước; \q họ đến các hồ chứa mà chẳng có nước; họ mang bình không trở về. \q Họ hổ thẹn và nhục nhã, và họ trùm đầu lại.
vi.R: Các nhà lãnh đạo sai đầy tớ đi lấy nước. \q Đầy tớ đến các hố chứa nước, nhưng không có nước. Họ mang vò không trở về. \q Họ thấy xấu hổ và nhục nhã, và họ trùm đầu lại.

ko.L: 그 귀족들이 어린 자들을 물 길으러 보내지만 \q 그들이 웅덩이에 가도 물을 찾지 못하고 빈 그릇으로 돌아온다. \q 그들이 부끄러워하고 수치를 당하여 머리를 가린다.
ko.B: 귀족들이 젊은 종들을 보내 물을 길어 오게 하지만, \q 그들이 물웅덩이에 가 보아도 물이 없어서 빈 그릇만 들고 돌아온다. \q 그들은 부끄럽고 창피하여 머리를 가린다.
ko.R: 지도자들이 종들을 보내 물을 길어 오게 한다. \q 종들이 물웅덩이에 가 보지만 물이 없다. 그들은 빈 항아리를 들고 돌아온다. \q 그들은 부끄럽고 창피해서 머리를 가린다.

pt.L: E os seus nobres mandam os seus pequenos buscar água; \q vão às cisternas, não acham água, voltam [com] os seus vasos vazios; \q estão envergonhados e humilhados, e cobrem a cabeça.
pt.B: Os seus nobres mandam os seus jovens servos buscar água; \q eles chegam às cisternas e não há água; os seus vasos voltam vazios. \q Eles ficam envergonhados e humilhados, e cobrem a cabeça.
pt.R: Os líderes mandam os seus servos buscar água. \q Os servos vão às cisternas onde se guarda a água da chuva, mas não há água. Voltam com os jarros vazios. \q Eles se sentem envergonhados e humilhados, e cobrem a cabeça.

am.L: መኳንንቶቻቸውም ታናናሾቻቸውን ውኃ እንዲያመጡ ይልካሉ፤ \q ወደ ጉድጓዶቹ ይመጣሉ፤ ውኃ አያገኙም፤ ዕቃዎቻቸውን ባዶ ይዘው ይመለሳሉ፤ \q ያፍራሉ፤ ይዋረዳሉም፤ ራሳቸውንም ይሸፍናሉ።
am.B: መኳንንቶቻቸው ውኃ እንዲቀዱ አገልጋዮቻቸውን ይልካሉ፤ \q ወደ ጉድጓዶቹ ይደርሳሉ፤ ውኃ ግን የለም፤ ዕቃዎቻቸውም ባዶ ሆነው ይመለሳሉ። \q አፍረዋል፤ ተዋርደዋልም፤ ራሳቸውንም ይሸፍናሉ።
am.R: መሪዎቹ ውኃ እንዲያመጡ አገልጋዮቻቸውን ይልካሉ። \q አገልጋዮቹ ወደ ውኃ ጉድጓዶቹ ይሄዳሉ፤ ውኃ ግን የለም። ባዶ እንስራቸውን ይዘው ይመለሳሉ። \q ኀፍረትና ውርደት ይሰማቸዋል፤ ራሳቸውንም ይሸፍናሉ።

hi.L: और उनके रईस अपने छोटों को पानी के लिए भेजते हैं; \q वे हौदों पर आते हैं, उन्हें पानी नहीं मिलता, वे अपने बरतन ख़ाली [लिए] लौट आते हैं; \q वे लज्जित और अपमानित हैं, और वे अपने सिर ढाँपते हैं।
hi.B: उनके रईस अपने जवान सेवकों को पानी लाने भेजते हैं; \q वे हौदों तक पहुँचते हैं, पर पानी नहीं है; उनके बरतन ख़ाली लौट आते हैं। \q वे लज्जित और अपमानित हैं, और वे अपने सिर ढाँप लेते हैं।
hi.R: अगुवे अपने सेवकों को पानी लाने भेजते हैं। \q सेवक पानी के गड्ढों तक जाते हैं, पर पानी नहीं मिलता। वे ख़ाली घड़े लेकर लौट आते हैं। \q वे लज्जित और अपमानित अनुभव करते हैं, और अपने सिर ढाँप लेते हैं।

ru.L: И знатные их посылают своих младших за водой; \q приходят к водоёмам, не находят воды, возвращаются с пустыми сосудами; \q стыдятся и посрамлены, и покрывают свои головы.
ru.B: Знатные посылают своих слуг за водой; \q те приходят к водоёмам — а воды нет; их сосуды возвращаются пустыми. \q Они пристыжены и опозорены и покрывают свои головы.
ru.R: Начальники посылают слуг за водой. \q Слуги идут к ямам с водой, но воды нет. Они возвращаются с пустыми кувшинами. \q Им стыдно и горько, и они покрывают свои головы.

ja.L: 彼らの貴人たちは、その若い者たちを水[くみ]に遣わす。 \q 彼らは水溜めに来るが、水を見いださず、その器を空のまま持って帰る。 \q 彼らは恥を見、辱められて、その頭を覆う。
ja.B: 身分の高い者たちは、召し使いたちを水くみに行かせる。 \q 彼らは水溜めに行くが、水はない。器は空のまま戻って来る。 \q 彼らは恥じ入り、面目を失って、頭を覆う。
ja.R: 指導者たちは、召し使いたちに水をくみに行かせる。 \q 召し使いたちは雨水をためる穴に行くが、水がない。空のつぼを持って帰って来る。 \q 彼らは恥ずかしく思い、面目を失って、頭を覆う。

uk.L: І їхні вельможі посилають своїх молодших по воду; \q вони приходять до водойм, не знаходять води, повертаються [з] порожнім посудом; \q вони осоромлені й принижені, і покривають свої голови.
uk.B: Їхні вельможі посилають своїх слуг по воду; \q ті приходять до водойм, а води немає; їхній посуд повертається порожній. \q Вони осоромлені й зганьблені, і покривають свої голови.
uk.R: Провідники посилають своїх слуг принести води. \q Слуги йдуть до водойм, але води немає. Вони повертаються з порожніми глеками. \q Їм соромно і прикро, і вони покривають свої голови.

decisions.choice: young ones: servants, the lowly members of the household
decisions.reason: The word means "little ones" or "young ones". Set beside "their nobles", it means the young or low-ranking servants sent out to do the work (48:4 uses the same word). The written text spells the word slightly differently from the form the scribes' margin says to read, with the same meaning; the reading form is followed here.

decisions.choice: cisterns: pits dug to hold rainwater
decisions.reason: The word names pits or hollows, often cut in rock, where rainwater collected (2 Kings 3:16; Isaiah 30:14). With no rain they stand empty. Jeremiah has already used empty, cracked cisterns as a picture of the people's false hopes (2:13).

decisions.choice: ashamed and humiliated ... cover their heads: signs of grief and disgrace
decisions.reason: "Ashamed" here is the shame of hopes that came to nothing: they went for water and came back with none. Covering the head was a sign of grief and humiliation (2 Samuel 15:30; Esther 6:12). The same words describe the farmers in verse 4.

decisions.choice: young servants / servants; cisterns / water pits; jars
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "servants" for the "young ones" (meaning decision m1). Readable calls the cisterns "water pits" and the vessels "jars", the usual containers for carrying water, and says "leaders" for the nobles.

decisions.choice: cisterns "ጉድጓዶች" (R "የውኃ ጉድጓዶች")
decisions.reason: The pits cut to hold rainwater are called by the everyday word for a water hole; Readable adds "water".
The cisterns were pits cut in rock to hold rainwater; "हौद" is a tank for water, and Readable describes them as water pits, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "водоёмы" (L, B); "ямы с водой" (R)
decisions.reason: Cisterns are pits dug to hold rainwater, not wells fed by springs; in a drought they are the first to run dry.

decisions.choice: tse'ireihem "若い者たち" (L), "召し使いたち" (B, R) (m1); gevim "水溜め" (L, B), "雨水をためる穴" (R) (m2); chafu ro'sham "頭を覆う" at every level, a gesture of grief (m3).
decisions.reason: As the meaning decisions and the English levels.

source.text: בַּעֲב֤וּר הָאֲדָמָה֙ חַ֔תָּה כִּ֛י לֹא־הָיָ֥ה גֶ֖שֶׁם בָּאָ֑רֶץ בֹּ֥שׁוּ אִכָּרִ֖ים חָפ֥וּ רֹאשָֽׁם׃

records.literal_gloss: Because of the ground [that] is shattered, for not there has been rain in the land, are ashamed [the] farmers, they have covered their head.

en.L: Because of the ground that is cracked, \q for there has been no rain in the land, \q the farmers are ashamed; they cover their heads.
en.B: Because of the ground, cracked open \q since no rain has come on the land, \q the farmers are put to shame; they cover their heads.
en.R: The ground has split open, \q since no rain has fallen on the land. \q The farmers are ashamed, and they cover their heads.

es.L: Por causa de la tierra que se ha agrietado, \q porque no ha habido lluvia en la tierra, \q los labradores se avergüenzan; cubren sus cabezas.
es.B: Por la tierra, agrietada \q porque no ha caído lluvia sobre el país, \q los labradores quedan en vergüenza; se cubren la cabeza.
es.R: La tierra se ha partido en grietas, \q porque no ha caído lluvia sobre el país. \q Los campesinos están avergonzados y se cubren la cabeza.

fr.L: À cause du sol qui est crevassé, \q car il n’y a pas eu de pluie dans le pays, \q les laboureurs sont honteux ; ils se couvrent la tête.
fr.B: À cause du sol crevassé, \q parce qu’aucune pluie n’est tombée sur le pays, \q les laboureurs sont couverts de honte ; ils se couvrent la tête.
fr.R: Le sol s’est fendu, \q parce qu’aucune pluie n’est tombée sur le pays. \q Les paysans ont honte, et ils se couvrent la tête.

sw.L: Kwa sababu ya ardhi iliyopasuka, \q kwa maana hakujanyesha mvua katika nchi, \q wakulima wanaona haya; wanajifunika vichwa vyao.
sw.B: Kwa sababu ya ardhi iliyopasukapasuka \q kwa kuwa hakuna mvua iliyonyesha juu ya nchi, \q wakulima wameaibishwa; wanajifunika vichwa.
sw.R: Ardhi imepasukapasuka, \q kwa sababu hakuna mvua iliyonyesha katika nchi. \q Wakulima wanaona aibu, nao wanajifunika vichwa.

vi.L: Vì đất nứt nẻ, \q vì không có mưa trong xứ, \q các nhà nông hổ thẹn; họ trùm đầu lại.
vi.B: Vì đất đã nứt nẻ \q bởi không có mưa trên xứ, \q các nhà nông phải hổ thẹn; họ trùm đầu lại.
vi.R: Đất đã nứt nẻ, \q vì không có mưa rơi trên xứ. \q Các nhà nông xấu hổ, và họ trùm đầu lại.

ko.L: 땅이 갈라졌기 때문에, \q 이 땅에 비가 내리지 않았기 때문에, \q 농부들이 부끄러워 머리를 가린다.
ko.B: 땅에 비가 오지 않아 \q 땅이 쩍쩍 갈라지니, \q 농부들이 낙심하여 머리를 가린다.
ko.R: 땅이 갈라졌다. \q 이 땅에 비가 내리지 않았기 때문이다. \q 농부들은 부끄러워 머리를 가린다.

pt.L: Por causa do solo que está rachado, \q pois não houve chuva na terra, \q os lavradores estão envergonhados; cobrem a cabeça.
pt.B: Por causa do solo, rachado \q porque não veio chuva sobre a terra, \q os lavradores ficam envergonhados; cobrem a cabeça.
pt.R: O chão se abriu em rachaduras, \q porque não caiu chuva na terra. \q Os agricultores estão envergonhados, e cobrem a cabeça.

am.L: ስለ ተሰነጣጠቀው መሬት፣ \q በምድሪቱ ላይ ዝናብ አልነበረምና፣ \q ገበሬዎች ያፍራሉ፤ ራሳቸውን ይሸፍናሉ።
am.B: ከተሰነጣጠቀው መሬት የተነሣ፣ \q በምድሪቱ ላይ ዝናብ አልወረደምና፣ \q ገበሬዎች አፍረዋል፤ ራሳቸውን ይሸፍናሉ።
am.R: መሬቱ ተሰነጣጥቋል፤ \q በምድሪቱ ላይ ዝናብ አልዘነበምና። \q ገበሬዎቹ አፍረዋል፤ ራሳቸውንም ይሸፍናሉ።

hi.L: उस भूमि के कारण जो फट गई है, \q क्योंकि देश में वर्षा नहीं हुई, \q किसान लज्जित हैं; वे अपने सिर ढाँपते हैं।
hi.B: भूमि के कारण, जो फट गई है \q क्योंकि देश पर वर्षा नहीं हुई, \q किसान लज्जित किए गए हैं; वे अपने सिर ढाँप लेते हैं।
hi.R: भूमि फट गई है, \q क्योंकि देश पर वर्षा नहीं हुई। \q किसान लज्जित हैं, और वे अपने सिर ढाँप लेते हैं।

ru.L: Из-за почвы, которая растрескалась, \q потому что не было дождя в стране, \q пристыжены земледельцы; покрывают свои головы.
ru.B: Из-за почвы, растрескавшейся \q оттого, что на землю не пришёл дождь, \q земледельцы посрамлены; они покрывают свои головы.
ru.R: Земля растрескалась, \q потому что на неё не выпал дождь. \q Земледельцам стыдно, и они покрывают свои головы.

ja.L: 大地がひび割れたために、 \q その地に雨が降らなかったので、 \q 農夫たちは恥を見、その頭を覆う。
ja.B: 大地はひび割れた。 \q その地に雨が降らなかったからだ。 \q 農夫たちは恥じ入り、頭を覆う。
ja.R: 地面がひび割れた。 \q 国に雨が降らなかったからだ。 \q 農夫たちは恥ずかしく思い、頭を覆う。

uk.L: Через землю, що потріскалася, \q бо не було дощу в краю, \q хлібороби осоромлені; вони покривають свої голови.
uk.B: Через землю, що потріскалася, \q бо на край не впав дощ, \q хлібороби осоромлені; вони покривають свої голови.
uk.R: Земля потріскалася, \q бо на край не впало дощу. \q Хліборобам соромно, і вони покривають свої голови.

decisions.choice: cracked: shattered, broken up; the word is also used of people dismayed
decisions.reason: The verb means to be shattered, and it is often used of people broken by fear or dismay (1:17; 8:9). Said of the ground, it pictures dry earth split open, and it may also hint that the land itself is dismayed, as Judah and its gates mourn in verse 2.

decisions.choice: farmers ashamed: their hopes for a harvest have failed
decisions.reason: The farmers are the men who plowed and worked the fields. They are "ashamed" in the same way as the water carriers of verse 3: they did their work, and the rain they counted on never came. They cover their heads as those in verse 3 do.

decisions.choice: The ground has split open, since no rain has fallen
decisions.reason: Readable makes "because of the ground" into a sentence of its own and lets the farmers' shame follow from it, keeping the sentence short.

decisions.choice: Balanced and Readable make the cracked ground a sentence of its own ("大地はひび割れた。") and give the reason on the next line, so each line stays in its own place.
decisions.reason: Japanese puts a 'because' clause before its main verb; two short sentences keep the line order of the Hebrew.

source.text: כִּ֤י גַם־אַיֶּ֨לֶת֙ בַּשָּׂדֶ֔ה יָלְדָ֖ה וְעָז֑וֹב כִּ֥י לֹֽא־הָיָ֖ה דֶּֽשֶׁא׃

records.literal_gloss: For even [the] doe in the field has given birth and abandoned, for not there is grass.

en.L: For even the doe in the field gives birth and abandons [her young], \q for there is no grass.
en.B: Even the doe in the open field gives birth and then leaves her young behind, \q because there is no grass.
en.R: Even a mother deer gives birth in the field and then leaves her baby, \q because there is no grass.

es.L: Porque aun la cierva en el campo da a luz y abandona [a su cría], \q porque no hay hierba.
es.B: Aun la cierva en campo abierto da a luz y luego abandona a su cría, \q porque no hay hierba.
es.R: Hasta una cierva da a luz en el campo y luego abandona a su cervatillo, \q porque no hay hierba.

fr.L: Car même la biche dans les champs met bas et abandonne [son petit], \q car il n’y a pas d’herbe.
fr.B: Même la biche, dans la campagne, met bas puis abandonne son petit, \q parce qu’il n’y a pas d’herbe.
fr.R: Même une maman biche met bas dans les champs, puis elle abandonne son petit, \q parce qu’il n’y a pas d’herbe.

sw.L: Kwa maana hata kulungu jike shambani anazaa na kumwacha [mtoto wake], \q kwa maana hakuna majani.
sw.B: Hata kulungu jike porini anazaa kisha anamwacha mtoto wake, \q kwa sababu hakuna majani.
sw.R: Hata kulungu mama anazaa mtoto shambani kisha anamwacha, \q kwa sababu hakuna majani.

vi.L: Ngay cả nai cái ngoài đồng cũng sinh con rồi bỏ [con], \q vì không có cỏ.
vi.B: Ngay cả nai cái ngoài đồng trống cũng sinh con rồi bỏ con lại, \q vì không có cỏ.
vi.R: Ngay cả nai mẹ cũng sinh con ngoài đồng rồi bỏ con mình, \q vì không có cỏ.

ko.L: 들의 암사슴도 새끼를 낳고서 [새끼를] 버린다. \q 풀이 없기 때문이다.
ko.B: 들판의 암사슴마저 새끼를 낳고서 그 새끼를 버린다. \q 풀이 없기 때문이다.
ko.R: 어미 사슴마저 들에서 새끼를 낳고는 그 새끼를 버리고 떠난다. \q 풀이 없기 때문이다.

pt.L: Pois até a corça no campo dá cria e abandona [o filhote], \q porque não há erva.
pt.B: Até a corça em campo aberto dá cria e depois abandona o filhote, \q porque não há capim.
pt.R: Até uma corça dá cria no campo e depois abandona o seu filhote, \q porque não há capim.

am.L: በሜዳ ያለችው ሚዳቋ እንኳ ትወልዳለች፤ [ልጇንም] ትተዋለች፤ \q ሣር የለምና።
am.B: በሜዳ ያለችው ሚዳቋ እንኳ ወልዳ ግልገሏን ትታ ትሄዳለች፤ \q ሣር የለምና።
am.R: እናት ሚዳቋ እንኳ በሜዳ ወልዳ ልጇን ትተዋለች፤ \q ሣር የለምና።

hi.L: क्योंकि मैदान में हिरनी भी जनती है और [अपने बच्चे को] छोड़ देती है, \q क्योंकि घास नहीं है।
hi.B: खुले मैदान में हिरनी भी बच्चा जनकर उसे छोड़ देती है, \q क्योंकि घास नहीं है।
hi.R: मैदान में हिरनी भी बच्चे को जन्म देकर उसे छोड़ देती है, \q क्योंकि घास नहीं है।

ru.L: Потому что даже лань в поле рождает и оставляет [детёныша], \q потому что нет травы.
ru.B: Даже лань в открытом поле рожает и тут же бросает своего детёныша, \q потому что нет травы.
ru.R: Даже лань рожает в поле и потом бросает своего оленёнка, \q потому что нет травы.

ja.L: 野の雌鹿でさえ、産んで[その子を]捨てる。 \q 青草がないからだ。
ja.B: 野の雌鹿でさえ、子を産んでも、その子を置き去りにする。 \q 草がないからだ。
ja.R: 母鹿でさえ、野で子を産んでも、その子を置いて行ってしまう。 \q 草がないからだ。

uk.L: Бо навіть лань у полі народжує і покидає [маля], \q бо немає трави.
uk.B: Навіть лань у відкритому полі народжує, а потім покидає своє маля, \q бо немає трави.
uk.R: Навіть оленячі матері народжують у полі, а потім покидають своїх малят, \q бо немає трави.

decisions.choice: gives birth and abandons: the second verb continues the first; the newborn is the one left
decisions.reason: The second verb is in a form (the infinitive) that carries on the action of the first: she gives birth and then leaves. No object is stated, but the one abandoned is the newborn.

decisions.choice: the doe: a mother animal that would not leave her young unless forced to
decisions.reason: The doe was a picture of gentleness and of tender care for its young (Proverbs 5:19; Job 39:1-4). That she leaves her newborn fawn to die shows how desperate the drought has become: even the strongest instinct of a mother fails when there is nothing to eat.

decisions.choice: [her young] / her young / her baby
decisions.reason: The object of "abandons" is supplied at every level (in brackets at Literal), since English needs one and the context makes it plain (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: doe "ሚዳቋ"
decisions.reason: A small deer-like animal of the open field that Amharic readers know; the point is a mother that would not leave her young.

decisions.choice: 'ayyelet "雌鹿" (L, B), "母鹿" (R, the English R "mother deer"); ve'azov "捨てる" (L), "置き去りにする" (B), "置いて行ってしまう" (R), the newborn as the object (m1).
decisions.reason: Animal names as the OT notes ('ayyalot 雌鹿); the supplied object in brackets at L as the English L.

source.text: וּפְרָאִים֙ עָמְד֣וּ עַל־שְׁפָיִ֔ם שָׁאֲפ֥וּ ר֖וּחַ כַּתַּנִּ֑ים כָּל֥וּ עֵינֵיהֶ֖ם כִּי־אֵ֥ין עֵֽשֶׂב׃

records.literal_gloss: And wild donkeys have stood on bare heights, they have panted [for] air like jackals; have failed their eyes, for there is no vegetation.

en.L: And wild donkeys stand on the bare heights; \q they pant for air like jackals; \q their eyes fail, for there is no vegetation.
en.B: Wild donkeys stand on the bare heights, \q gasping for air like jackals; \q their eyes grow dim, because there are no plants.
en.R: Wild donkeys stand on bare hilltops, \q gasping for breath like jackals. \q Their eyes grow weak, because nothing green is growing.

es.L: Y los asnos monteses se paran sobre las alturas desnudas; \q jadean buscando aire como chacales; \q sus ojos desfallecen, porque no hay vegetación.
es.B: Los asnos salvajes se paran en las alturas peladas, \q jadeando como chacales; \q sus ojos se apagan, porque no hay plantas.
es.R: Los burros salvajes se paran en las colinas peladas, \q jadeando como chacales. \q Sus ojos se debilitan, porque no crece nada verde.

fr.L: Et les ânes sauvages se tiennent sur les hauteurs dénudées ; \q ils aspirent l’air comme des chacals ; \q leurs yeux s’éteignent, car il n’y a pas de verdure.
fr.B: Les ânes sauvages se tiennent sur les hauteurs dénudées, \q haletant comme des chacals ; \q leurs yeux s’éteignent, parce qu’il n’y a pas de plantes.
fr.R: Les ânes sauvages se tiennent sur les collines dénudées. \q Ils ont du mal à respirer, comme des chacals. \q Leurs yeux faiblissent, parce que rien de vert ne pousse.

sw.L: Na punda-mwitu wanasimama juu ya vilele vilivyo wazi; \q wanatweta wakivuta hewa kama mbweha; \q macho yao yanafifia, kwa maana hakuna mimea.
sw.B: Punda-mwitu wanasimama juu ya vilele vilivyo wazi, \q wakitweta kuvuta hewa kama mbweha; \q macho yao yanafifia, kwa sababu hakuna mimea.
sw.R: Punda-mwitu wanasimama juu ya vilima vilivyo wazi, \q wakitweta kama mbweha. \q Macho yao yanadhoofika, kwa sababu hakuna kitu kibichi kinachoota.

vi.L: Lừa rừng đứng trên các đồi trọc; \q chúng thở hổn hển như chó rừng; \q mắt chúng mờ đi, vì không có cây cỏ.
vi.B: Lừa rừng đứng trên các đồi trọc, \q thở hổn hển như chó rừng; \q mắt chúng mờ đi, vì không còn cây cỏ.
vi.R: Lừa rừng đứng trên các đỉnh đồi trọc, \q thở hổn hển như chó rừng. \q Mắt chúng yếu dần, vì không có gì xanh mọc lên.

ko.L: 들나귀들이 벌거숭이 언덕 위에 서서 \q 승냥이처럼 헐떡이며 숨을 들이켜고, \q 풀이 없어서 눈이 흐려진다.
ko.B: 들나귀들은 벌거숭이 언덕에 서서 \q 승냥이처럼 숨을 헐떡이고, \q 먹을 풀이 없어 눈이 흐려진다.
ko.R: 들나귀들은 민둥산 꼭대기에 서서 \q 승냥이처럼 숨을 헐떡인다. \q 푸른 풀이 하나도 자라지 않아 눈이 침침해진다.

pt.L: E os jumentos selvagens ficam de pé sobre as alturas desnudas; \q ofegam [por] ar como chacais; \q os seus olhos desfalecem, porque não há vegetação.
pt.B: Os jumentos selvagens ficam de pé nos topos descampados das colinas, \q respirando com dificuldade como chacais; \q os seus olhos perdem o brilho, porque não há plantas.
pt.R: Os jumentos selvagens ficam de pé nos topos das colinas sem árvores, \q ofegando como chacais. \q Os seus olhos ficam fracos, porque não cresce nada verde.

am.L: የዱር አህዮችም በራቁት ኮረብቶች ላይ ይቆማሉ፤ \q እንደ ቀበሮዎች አየርን ያለከልካሉ፤ \q ለምለም ነገር የለምና ዓይኖቻቸው ደከሙ።
am.B: የዱር አህዮች በራቁት ኮረብቶች ላይ ቆመው \q እንደ ቀበሮዎች አየር ለማግኘት ያለከልካሉ፤ \q ቡቃያ የለምና ዓይኖቻቸው ፈዘዋል።
am.R: የዱር አህዮች በራቁት ኮረብቶች ላይ ይቆማሉ፤ \q እንደ ቀበሮዎች እያለከለኩ ይተነፍሳሉ። \q አረንጓዴ ነገር ስለማይበቅል ዓይኖቻቸው ደክመዋል።

hi.L: और जंगली गधे मुंडी पहाड़ियों पर खड़े हैं; \q वे गीदड़ों की तरह हवा के लिए हाँफते हैं; \q उनकी आँखें धुँधला जाती हैं, क्योंकि कोई हरियाली नहीं।
hi.B: जंगली गधे मुंडी पहाड़ियों पर खड़े हैं, \q गीदड़ों की तरह हवा के लिए हाँफते हुए; \q उनकी आँखें धुँधली पड़ जाती हैं, क्योंकि कोई पौधे नहीं।
hi.R: जंगली गधे नंगी पहाड़ियों पर खड़े हैं, \q गीदड़ों की तरह साँस के लिए हाँफ रहे हैं। \q उनकी आँखें कमज़ोर हो जाती हैं, क्योंकि कहीं कुछ हरा नहीं उग रहा।

ru.L: И дикие ослы стоят на голых высотах, \q глотают воздух, как шакалы; \q гаснут их глаза, потому что нет зелени.
ru.B: Дикие ослы стоят на голых высотах, \q хватают ртом воздух, как шакалы; \q их глаза тускнеют, потому что нет растений.
ru.R: Дикие ослы стоят на голых холмах \q и тяжело дышат, как шакалы. \q Их глаза слабеют, потому что ничего зелёного не растёт.

ja.L: 野ろばは、はげ山の上に立ち、 \q ジャッカルのように風をあえぎ求める。 \q その目は衰える。草がないからだ。
ja.B: 野ろばは、木のない丘の上に立ち、 \q ジャッカルのように息をあえがせる。 \q その目はかすんでいく。草がないからだ。
ja.R: 野生のろばは、はげた丘の上に立ち、 \q ジャッカルのように息を切らしている。 \q その目は弱っていく。緑の草が一本も生えていないからだ。

uk.L: І дикі осли стоять на голих висотах; \q вони хапають повітря, як шакали; \q їхні очі тьмяніють, бо немає зелені.
uk.B: Дикі осли стоять на голих висотах, \q хапаючи повітря, як шакали; \q їхні очі тьмяніють, бо немає рослин.
uk.R: Дикі осли стоять на голих вершинах пагорбів, \q хапаючи повітря, як шакали. \q Їхні очі слабнуть, бо нічого зеленого не росте.

decisions.choice: bare heights: open, treeless hills
decisions.reason: The word names high, bare places with no trees (3:2, 21; 4:11; Isaiah 41:18). The wild donkeys, animals of the open country (2:24; Job 39:5-8), go up to them in search of wind or water.

decisions.choice: pant for air like jackals: gasp open-mouthed, sniffing the wind
decisions.reason: The verb means to gasp or pant, or to sniff eagerly at the air (2:24 uses it of a wild donkey sniffing the wind). Jackals were known as animals of waste places that howl and pant (9:10; 10:22). Here the donkeys stand with mouths open, weak from thirst.

decisions.choice: their eyes fail: they grow dim from weakness and from looking in vain
decisions.reason: Eyes that "fail" or "are spent" are eyes dimmed by hunger, weakness or long waiting for help that does not come (Lamentations 4:17; Psalms 69:4).

decisions.choice: nothing green is growing
decisions.reason: Readable explains "vegetation" in plain words: no green plants are growing for the animals to eat.

decisions.choice: pera'im "野ろば" (L, B), "野生のろば" (R); shefayim "はげ山" (L), "木のない丘" (B), "はげた丘" (R), as 3:2; tannim "ジャッカル" at every level.
decisions.reason: Forms settled in the ISA and JER notes.

source.text: אִם־עֲוֺנֵ֨ינוּ֙ עָ֣נוּ בָ֔נוּ יְהוָ֕ה עֲשֵׂ֖ה לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמֶ֑ךָ כִּֽי־רַבּ֥וּ מְשׁוּבֹתֵ֖ינוּ לְךָ֥ חָטָֽאנוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Though our iniquities have testified against us, Yahweh, act for the sake of your name; for many are our turnings away, against you we have sinned.

en.L: Though our iniquities testify against us, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, \q act for the sake of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name; \q for our turnings away are many; against {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} we have sinned.
en.B: Even though our sins bear witness against us, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, \q act for the sake of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name; \q for we have turned away many times; we have sinned against {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, our sins speak against us. \q But act to help us, for the honor of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name. \q We have turned away from {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} again and again. We have sinned against {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

es.L: Aunque nuestras iniquidades testifican contra nosotros, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q actúa por amor de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre; \q porque muchas son nuestras apostasías; contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} hemos pecado.
es.B: Aunque nuestros pecados dan testimonio contra nosotros, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q actúa por amor de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre; \q porque nos hemos apartado muchas veces; hemos pecado contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, nuestros pecados hablan en contra de nosotros. \q Pero ayúdanos, por la honra de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre. \q Nos hemos apartado de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} una y otra vez. Hemos pecado contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.

fr.L: Si nos fautes témoignent contre nous, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q agis à cause de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom ; \q car nos infidélités sont nombreuses ; contre {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} nous avons péché.
fr.B: Même si nos péchés témoignent contre nous, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q agis à cause de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom ; \q car nous nous sommes détournés bien des fois ; nous avons péché contre {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, nos péchés parlent contre nous. \q Mais agis pour nous aider, pour l’honneur de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom. \q Nous nous sommes détournés de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} encore et encore. Nous avons péché contre {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.

sw.L: Ingawa maovu yetu yanashuhudia juu yetu, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q tenda kwa ajili ya jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}; \q kwa maana kurudi nyuma kwetu ni kwingi; tumekutenda dhambi {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}.
sw.B: Ingawa dhambi zetu zinashuhudia dhidi yetu, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q tenda kwa ajili ya jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}; \q kwa maana tumerudi nyuma mara nyingi; tumekutenda dhambi.
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, dhambi zetu zinatushtaki. \q Lakini utusaidie kwa ajili ya heshima ya jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}. \q Tumekuacha tena na tena. Tumekutenda dhambi.

vi.L: Dù tội ác của chúng con làm chứng nghịch cùng chúng con, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q xin hành động vì danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q vì sự bội nghịch của chúng con nhiều lắm; chúng con đã phạm tội nghịch cùng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, dù tội lỗi chúng con làm chứng nghịch cùng chúng con, \q xin vì danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà hành động; \q vì chúng con đã nhiều lần bội nghịch; chúng con đã phạm tội nghịch cùng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tội lỗi chúng con buộc tội chúng con. \q Nhưng xin vì danh dự của danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà ra tay giúp chúng con. \q Chúng con đã nhiều lần quay lưng với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Chúng con đã phạm tội nghịch cùng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저희 죄악이 저희에게 불리하게 증언하더라도 \q 주님의 이름을 위하여 일하여 주십시오. \q 저희의 돌아섬이 많고, 저희가 주님께 죄를 지었습니다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저희 죄가 저희를 고발하더라도 \q 주님의 이름을 위하여 일하여 주십시오. \q 저희가 여러 번 주님을 떠나 돌아섰고, 주님께 죄를 지었습니다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저희 죄가 저희를 고발합니다. \q 그래도 주님의 이름의 명예를 위하여 저희를 도와주십시오. \q 저희는 몇 번이고 주님에게서 돌아섰습니다. 저희는 주님께 죄를 지었습니다.

pt.L: Ainda que as nossas iniquidades testemunhem contra nós, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, \q age por amor do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome; \q pois as nossas infidelidades são muitas; contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} pecamos.
pt.B: Mesmo que os nossos pecados testemunhem contra nós, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, \q age por amor do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome; \q pois muitas vezes fomos infiéis; pecamos contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
pt.R: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, os nossos pecados falam contra nós. \q Mas age para nos ajudar, pela honra do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome. \q Muitas e muitas vezes fomos infiéis a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. Pecamos contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ በደላችን ቢመሰክርብንም፣ \q ስለ ስምህ ብለህ አድርግ፤ \q ከአንተ መራቃችን ብዙ ነውና፤ በአንተ ላይ ኃጢአት ሠርተናል።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ኃጢአታችን ቢመሰክርብንም፣ \q ስለ ስምህ ብለህ ሥራ፤ \q ብዙ ጊዜ ከአንተ ርቀናልና፤ በአንተ ላይ ኃጢአት ሠርተናል።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ኃጢአታችን ይከሰናል። \q ነገር ግን ለስምህ ክብር ስትል እርዳን። \q ደጋግመን ከአንተ ርቀናል፤ በአንተ ላይ ኃጢአት ሠርተናል።

hi.L: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, चाहे हमारे अधर्म हमारे विरुद्ध गवाही देते हैं, \q तो भी अपने नाम के निमित्त काम कर; \q क्योंकि हमारे भटकाव बहुत हैं; हमने तेरे विरुद्ध पाप किया है।
hi.B: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, चाहे हमारे पाप हमारे विरुद्ध गवाही देते हैं, \q तो भी अपने नाम के लिए कुछ कर; \q क्योंकि हम बहुत बार भटक गए हैं; हमने तेरे विरुद्ध पाप किया है।
hi.R: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, हमारे पाप हमारे विरुद्ध बोलते हैं। \q पर अपने नाम के आदर के लिए हमारी सहायता कर। \q हम बार-बार तुझसे मुड़ गए हैं। हमने तेरे विरुद्ध पाप किया है।

ru.L: Хотя наши беззакония свидетельствуют против нас, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, \q действуй ради {{deity_pronoun:твоего|Твоего}} имени; \q потому что многочисленны наши отступничества; против {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} мы согрешили.
ru.B: Хотя наши грехи свидетельствуют против нас, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, \q действуй ради {{deity_pronoun:твоего|Твоего}} имени; \q ведь мы много раз отступали; мы согрешили против {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, наши грехи говорят против нас. \q Но помоги нам ради чести {{deity_pronoun:твоего|Твоего}} имени. \q Мы снова и снова отворачивались от {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}. Мы согрешили против {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}.

ja.L: たとえ、わたしたちの咎がわたしたちに不利な証言をしても、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、 \q あなたの名のために事を行ってほしい。 \q わたしたちの背きは多く、わたしたちはあなたに罪を犯したのだから。
ja.B: わたしたちの罪がわたしたちを訴えていても、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、 \q あなたの名のために行動してほしい。 \q わたしたちは何度も背信を重ね、あなたに罪を犯してきたのだから。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしたちの罪が、わたしたちを責めている。 \q それでも、あなたの名誉のために、わたしたちを助けてほしい。 \q わたしたちは何度も何度もあなたに背を向け、あなたに罪を犯してきた。

uk.L: Хоч наші беззаконня свідчать проти нас, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, \q учини заради {{deity_pronoun:твого|Твого}} імені; \q бо численні наші відступництва; проти {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} ми згрішили.
uk.B: Хоч наші гріхи свідчать проти нас, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, \q учини заради {{deity_pronoun:твого|Твого}} імені; \q бо ми багато разів відверталися; ми згрішили проти {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, наші гріхи свідчать проти нас. \q Але допоможи нам заради честі {{deity_pronoun:твого|Твого}} імені. \q Ми знову й знову відверталися від {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}. Ми згрішили проти {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}.

decisions.choice: a new voice: the people pray to the LORD
decisions.reason: After the picture of the drought (verses 2-6), the people (or the prophet speaking for them) turn to God in prayer (verses 7-9). The LORD answers in verse 10. A second prayer follows in verses 19-22.

decisions.choice: our iniquities testify against us: our sins stand as witnesses in court
decisions.reason: The verb is used of a witness giving evidence (Numbers 35:30; Isaiah 59:12). The people admit that their own wrongs speak against them before God; they do not plead innocence.

decisions.choice: for the sake of your name: the plea rests on who God is, not on the people's merit
decisions.reason: God's name is his reputation and character as he has made himself known. Since the people have no right to help, they appeal to God's own honor and faithfulness (verse 21; Psalms 25:11; 79:9; Ezekiel 20:9).

decisions.choice: turnings away: acts of unfaithfulness, falling away from God
decisions.reason: The noun comes from the verb "turn" or "return" and means turning away from God. Jeremiah uses it for Israel's repeated unfaithfulness (2:19; 3:22; 5:6), playing on God's call to "return".

decisions.choice: sins (for iniquities); act to help us, for the honor of your name
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "sins" for the word rendered "iniquities" at Literal, as in Isaiah. Readable says what the act is ("to help us") and explains "for the sake of your name" as "for the honor of your name" (meaning decision m3).

decisions.choice: the people's prayer without quotation marks
decisions.reason: A new voice, the people praying (meaning decision m1), set like the rest of the poem without quotation marks, as the English does.

decisions.choice: the people pray: "chúng con", "lạy CHÚA", "Ngài"
decisions.reason: The terms note's forms for the people praying, kept in the prayers of verses 7-9 and 19-22.

decisions.choice: the people's prayer in 합쇼체 with 저희
alternatives: | Verses 7-9 and 19-22 are a communal lament addressed to God, so they take the polite speech of prayer with the communal 저희, as the terms note sets.

decisions.choice: tu (the people's prayer, verses 7-9 and 19-22); infidelidades (L), fomos infiéis (B, R)
decisions.reason: The people turn to God in prayer (m1), and like Jeremiah in his laments they say "tu", with the deity_pronoun setting. The "turnings away" (m4) take the word 2:19 sets for the book, "infidelidade", which Readable keeps too, so the reader hears that they confess the very thing God charged them with.

decisions.choice: turnings away (meshuvot) "ከአንተ መራቅ"
decisions.reason: Where the English says "turning away", the terms list keeps the picture of moving away from God (as 8:5).

decisions.choice: the people's prayer (verses 7-9, 19-22) speaks to God with "አንተ"
decisions.reason: As the style guide for prayer.

decisions.choice: "तू", "तेरे" in the people's prayer
decisions.reason: The people pray to God in verses 7-9 and 19-22, so they say "तू"; God's words to Jeremiah in verses 10-18 use "तुम". There are no deity_pronoun spans in Hindi, since Devanagari has no capitals.

decisions.choice: "ради твоего имени" with a span
decisions.reason: The English has a deity_pronoun span on "your"; Russian could use the reflexive "своего" after an imperative, but "твоего" keeps the span the English has. The same in verse 21.

decisions.choice: The people's prayer (m1) in verse is plain at every level, God "あなた", the request "〜てほしい" ("事を行ってほしい" L, "行動してほしい" B, "助けてほしい" R), as 2:27 and the prophetic conventions.
alternatives: "行ってください" (polite request, as in the Psalms)
decisions.reason: JEREMIAH CONVENTIONS: the people quoted keep their own register; their cry to God is plain with 〜てほしい.

decisions.choice: meshuvoteinu "わたしたちの背き" (L), "背信" (B), "あなたに背を向け" (R), the meshuvah row of the JER table.
decisions.reason: One family of words for shuv and meshuvah through the book.

source.text: מִקְוֵה֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מֽוֹשִׁיע֖וֹ בְּעֵ֣ת צָרָ֑ה לָ֤מָּה תִֽהְיֶה֙ כְּגֵ֣ר בָּאָ֔רֶץ וּכְאֹרֵ֖חַ נָטָ֥ה לָלֽוּן׃

records.literal_gloss: Hope of Israel, its savior in a time of distress, why should you be like a sojourner in the land, and like a traveler [who] has turned aside to spend the night?

en.L: Hope of Israel, its savior in a time of distress, \q why should {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} be like a sojourner in the land, \q and like a traveler who turns aside to spend the night?
en.B: Hope of Israel, who saves it in a time of trouble, \q why do {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} seem an outsider in the land, \q a traveler who turns aside to camp for one night?
en.R: Israel hopes in {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} save them in times of trouble. \q So why do {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} act like a stranger in this land, \q like someone passing through who only stops to sleep?

es.L: Esperanza de Israel, su salvador en tiempo de angustia, \q ¿por qué has de ser como forastero en la tierra, \q y como caminante que se desvía para pasar la noche?
es.B: Esperanza de Israel, que lo salvas en tiempo de angustia, \q ¿por qué pareces un extraño en el país, \q un viajero que se aparta del camino para acampar una noche?
es.R: Israel pone su esperanza en {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}; {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} lo salvas en tiempos de angustia. \q Entonces, ¿por qué actúas como un extraño en esta tierra, \q como alguien que va de paso y solo se detiene a dormir?

fr.L: Espérance d’Israël, son sauveur au temps de la détresse, \q pourquoi serais-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} comme un immigré dans le pays, \q et comme un voyageur qui fait un détour pour passer la nuit ?
fr.B: Espérance d’Israël, {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui le sauves au temps de la détresse, \q pourquoi es-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} comme un étranger dans le pays, \q comme un voyageur qui s’arrête pour camper une seule nuit ?
fr.R: Israël met son espoir en {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} le sauves quand il est en détresse. \q Alors pourquoi agis-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} comme un étranger dans ce pays, \q comme quelqu’un qui passe et ne s’arrête que pour dormir ?

sw.L: Ee Tumaini la Israeli, mwokozi wake wakati wa taabu, \q mbona unakuwa kama mgeni katika nchi, \q na kama msafiri anayegeuka kando kulala usiku mmoja?
sw.B: Ee Tumaini la Israeli, unayemwokoa wakati wa taabu, \q mbona unaonekana kama mgeni katika nchi, \q msafiri anayegeuka kando kupiga kambi usiku mmoja tu?
sw.R: Israeli wanakutumaini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}; unawaokoa nyakati za taabu. \q Basi kwa nini unakuwa kama mgeni katika nchi hii, \q kama mpita njia anayesimama tu ili kulala?

vi.L: Hỡi Niềm Hy Vọng của Y-sơ-ra-ên, Đấng giải cứu nó trong lúc hoạn nạn, \q sao {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lại như khách lạ trong xứ, \q như lữ khách rẽ vào nghỉ qua đêm?
vi.B: Lạy Niềm Hy Vọng của Y-sơ-ra-ên, Đấng giải cứu Y-sơ-ra-ên trong lúc gian nan, \q sao {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lại như người ngoại kiều trong xứ, \q như lữ khách chỉ rẽ vào cắm trại một đêm?
vi.R: Dân Y-sơ-ra-ên trông cậy nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giải cứu họ trong lúc hoạn nạn. \q Vậy sao {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lại hành động như một người xa lạ trong xứ này, \q như một người đi ngang qua chỉ dừng lại để ngủ?

ko.L: 이스라엘의 소망이시요, 환난의 때에 그를 구원하시는 분이시여, \q 어찌하여 주님께서 이 땅에서 나그네처럼, \q 하룻밤을 묵으려고 들른 길손처럼 되시렵니까?
ko.B: 이스라엘의 소망이시요, 어려울 때 이스라엘을 구원하시는 분이시여, \q 어찌하여 주님께서는 이 땅에서 낯선 사람처럼, \q 하룻밤 묵으려고 들른 나그네처럼 되셨습니까?
ko.R: 이스라엘은 주님께 소망을 둡니다. 주님은 어려울 때 이스라엘을 구해 주십니다. \q 그런데 어찌하여 주님께서는 이 땅에서 낯선 사람처럼 행동하십니까? \q 잠만 자고 지나가는 나그네처럼 행동하십니까?

pt.L: Esperança de Israel, o seu salvador no tempo da angústia, \q por que serias {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} como um estrangeiro na terra, \q e como um viajante que se desvia para passar a noite?
pt.B: Esperança de Israel, que o salvas no tempo da angústia, \q por que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pareces um forasteiro na terra, \q um viajante que se desvia para acampar uma só noite?
pt.R: Israel espera em {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} o salvas nos tempos de angústia. \q Então, por que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ages como um estranho nesta terra, \q como alguém de passagem que só se detém para dormir?

am.L: የእስራኤል ተስፋ፣ በመከራ ጊዜ አዳኙ ሆይ፣ \q በምድሪቱ ውስጥ ለምን እንደ መጻተኛ፣ \q ለማደርም ዘወር እንደሚል መንገደኛ ትሆናለህ?
am.B: የእስራኤል ተስፋ፣ በችግር ጊዜ የምታድነው ሆይ፣ \q በምድሪቱ ለምን እንደ ባዕድ ትመስላለህ? \q ለአንድ ሌሊት ለማረፍ ዘወር እንደሚል መንገደኛ?
am.R: እስራኤል ተስፋ የሚያደርገው በአንተ ነው፤ በችግር ጊዜ የምታድናቸው አንተ ነህ። \q ታዲያ በዚህች ምድር ለምን እንደ እንግዳ ትሆናለህ? \q ለማደር ብቻ እንደሚቆም መንገደኛ?

hi.L: हे इस्राएल की आशा, संकट के समय उसके उद्धारकर्ता, \q तू देश में परदेशी के समान \q और रात बिताने को रुकनेवाले यात्री के समान क्यों हो?
hi.B: हे इस्राएल की आशा, संकट के समय उसे बचानेवाले, \q तू देश में पराए जैसा क्यों लगता है, \q उस यात्री जैसा जो एक रात डेरा डालने को मुड़ता है?
hi.R: इस्राएल तुझ पर आशा रखता है; संकट के समय तू उन्हें बचाता है। \q तो फिर तू इस देश में अजनबी जैसा व्यवहार क्यों करता है, \q उस राही जैसा जो केवल सोने के लिए रुकता है?

ru.L: Надежда Израиля, его Спаситель во время бедствия, \q почему {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} будешь как пришелец в этой земле \q и как путник, свернувший переночевать?
ru.B: Надежда Израиля, спасающий его во время беды, \q почему {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} словно чужой в этой стране, \q словно путник, который зашёл лишь на одну ночь?
ru.R: Израиль надеется на {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}; {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} спасаешь его во времена беды. \q Так почему {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} ведёшь себя как чужой в этой стране, \q как прохожий, который останавливается только переночевать?

ja.L: イスラエルの望みである方、苦難の時のその救い主よ、 \q なぜ、あなたはこの地で寄留者のようになり、 \q 一夜を過ごすために道をそれる旅人のようになられるのか？
ja.B: イスラエルの望みである方、苦難の時にイスラエルを救う方よ、 \q なぜ、あなたはこの地で寄留者のようになり、 \q 一夜の宿のために立ち寄るだけの旅人のようになられるのか？
ja.R: イスラエルはあなたに望みをかけている。あなたは、苦しい時に彼らを救ってくださる。 \q それなのに、なぜあなたは、この国でよそから来た人のようにふるまわれるのか？ \q 寝るためにだけ立ち寄る旅人のように。

uk.L: Надіє Ізраїля, його спасителю в час біди, \q чому {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} маєш бути, як приходько в краю, \q і як подорожній, що звертає переночувати?
uk.B: Надіє Ізраїля, що спасаєш його в час біди, \q чому {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} здаєшся чужим у краю, \q подорожнім, що звертає на одну ніч?
uk.R: Ізраїль покладає надію на {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}; {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} рятуєш їх у часи біди. \q То чому {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} поводишся, як чужинець у цій землі, \q як той, хто проходить мимо і зупиняється лише переспати?

decisions.choice: Hope of Israel: the one Israel waits for and trusts
decisions.reason: The noun means hope or the object of hope. Jeremiah uses the title again (17:13; compare 50:7), where it stands beside "the spring of living water". The noun can also mean a pool of water, a fitting double sense in a prayer for rain.

decisions.choice: a sojourner ... a traveler: people with no lasting stake in the land
decisions.reason: A sojourner was a foreigner living in a land not his own, and a traveler stopped only for a night on his way somewhere else. The people complain that God, who should be at home among them, acts as if their land and its trouble were no concern of his. The verb "turns aside" may also mean "pitches [a tent]".

decisions.choice: why should you be: a complaint, not a request for information
decisions.reason: The question is a lament, like those in the psalms (Psalms 10:1; 22:2). It protests that God's apparent absence does not fit who he is.

decisions.choice: outsider (Balanced); stranger (Readable)
decisions.reason: The word rendered "sojourner" at Literal is "outsider" at Balanced and "stranger" at Readable, the wording used for it in 22:3 and since Leviticus; both suit the picture of someone not at home in the land.

decisions.choice: Israel hopes in you; you save them
decisions.reason: Readable turns the two titles of God into statements, so that the address is clear before the question.

decisions.choice: "un immigré" (L, for *ger*); "un étranger" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the word settled for *ger*; Balanced and Readable say "étranger", since the point here is a passing visitor with no home in the land.

decisions.choice: sojourner (ger) "መጻተኛ"
decisions.reason: As the Pentateuch terms list.

decisions.choice: "परदेशी" (L); "पराए" (B); "अजनबी" (R)
decisions.reason: The ger is "परदेशी", as Ezra and the Pentateuch; Balanced and Readable use plainer words for one who does not belong, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "Надежда Израиля, его Спаситель" with capitals
decisions.reason: The words are titles used to address God, so they take capitals as names do.

decisions.choice: miqveh Yisra'el "イスラエルの望みである方" (L, B), "イスラエルはあなたに望みをかけている" (R, as the English R); moshi'o "その救い主" (L), "イスラエルを救う方" (B); ger "寄留者" (L, B), "よそから来た人" (R), as 7:6.
decisions.reason: m1-m2; the people speak of God's acts with light respect forms ("なられる", "救ってくださる").

source.text: לָ֤מָּה תִֽהְיֶה֙ כְּאִ֣ישׁ נִדְהָ֔ם כְּגִבּ֖וֹר לֹא־יוּכַ֣ל לְהוֹשִׁ֑יעַ וְאַתָּ֧ה בְקִרְבֵּ֣נוּ יְהוָ֗ה וְשִׁמְךָ֛ עָלֵ֥ינוּ נִקְרָ֖א אַל־תַּנִּחֵֽנוּ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Why should you be like a man confounded, like a warrior [who] not is able to save? And you [are] in our midst, Yahweh, and your name over us is called; do not leave us.

en.L: Why should {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} be like a man taken by surprise, \q like a warrior who is not able to save? \q Yet {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are in our midst, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name is called over us; do not leave us.
en.B: Why are {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} like someone stunned, \q like a soldier who cannot save anyone? \q Yet {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are among us, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name is spoken over us; do not abandon us.
en.R: Why are {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} like a man who does not know what to do, \q like a fighter who cannot rescue anyone? \q {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are here with us, and we belong to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. Do not leave us!

es.L: ¿Por qué has de ser como un hombre aturdido, \q como un guerrero que no puede salvar? \q Sin embargo, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} estás en medio de nosotros, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre es invocado sobre nosotros; no nos dejes.
es.B: ¿Por qué estás como alguien pasmado, \q como un soldado que no puede salvar a nadie? \q Pero {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} estás entre nosotros, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre se pronuncia sobre nosotros; no nos abandones.
es.R: ¿Por qué estás como un hombre que no sabe qué hacer, \q como un luchador que no puede rescatar a nadie? \q {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} estás aquí con nosotros, y te pertenecemos. ¡No nos dejes!

fr.L: Pourquoi serais-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} comme un homme pris au dépourvu, \q comme un guerrier qui ne peut pas sauver ? \q Pourtant {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es au milieu de nous, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom est invoqué sur nous ; ne nous abandonne pas.
fr.B: Pourquoi es-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} comme quelqu’un de désemparé, \q comme un soldat incapable de sauver ? \q Pourtant {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es parmi nous, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom est prononcé sur nous ; ne nous abandonne pas.
fr.R: Pourquoi es-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} comme un homme qui ne sait pas quoi faire, \q comme un combattant qui ne peut sauver personne ? \q {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es ici avec nous, et nous {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}appartenons. Ne nous abandonne pas !

sw.L: Mbona unakuwa kama mtu aliyeshtushwa, \q kama shujaa asiyeweza kuokoa? \q Lakini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} uko katikati yetu, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} limeitwa juu yetu; usituache.
sw.B: Mbona uko kama mtu aliyepigwa na bumbuazi, \q kama askari asiyeweza kumwokoa mtu? \q Lakini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} uko kati yetu, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} limetajwa juu yetu; usituache.
sw.R: Kwa nini uko kama mtu asiyejua la kufanya, \q kama mpiganaji asiyeweza kumwokoa mtu yeyote? \q Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} uko hapa pamoja nasi, nasi ni mali {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}. Usituache!

vi.L: Sao {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lại như một người bị bất ngờ, \q như một dũng sĩ không thể giải cứu? \q Thế nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở giữa chúng con, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} được kêu trên chúng con; xin đừng lìa bỏ chúng con.
vi.B: Sao {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lại như người sững sờ, \q như chiến binh không cứu được ai? \q Thế nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở giữa chúng con, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} được xưng trên chúng con; xin đừng bỏ chúng con.
vi.R: Sao {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lại như một người không biết phải làm gì, \q như một chiến sĩ không giải cứu được ai? \q Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở đây với chúng con, và chúng con thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Xin đừng lìa bỏ chúng con!

ko.L: 어찌하여 주님께서 놀라 어쩔 줄 모르는 사람처럼, \q 구원할 수 없는 용사처럼 되시렵니까? \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님은 저희 가운데 계시고, 저희는 주님의 이름으로 불립니다. 저희를 떠나지 마십시오.
ko.B: 어찌하여 주님께서는 넋을 잃은 사람처럼, \q 아무도 구하지 못하는 용사처럼 되셨습니까? \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님은 저희 가운데 계시고, 저희는 주님의 이름으로 불리는 백성입니다. 저희를 버리지 마십시오.
ko.R: 어찌하여 주님께서는 어찌할 바를 모르는 사람처럼, \q 아무도 구해 내지 못하는 군인처럼 되셨습니까? \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님은 여기 저희와 함께 계십니다. 저희는 주님께 속한 백성입니다. 저희를 떠나지 마십시오!

pt.L: Por que serias {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} como um homem desconcertado, \q como um guerreiro que não pode salvar? \q Contudo {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} estás no nosso meio, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, e o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome é invocado sobre nós; não nos deixes.
pt.B: Por que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} estás como alguém atordoado, \q como um soldado que não consegue salvar ninguém? \q Mas {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} estás entre nós, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, e o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome é pronunciado sobre nós; não nos abandones.
pt.R: Por que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} estás como um homem que não sabe o que fazer, \q como um lutador que não consegue salvar ninguém? \q {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} estás aqui conosco, e nós pertencemos a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. Não nos deixes!

am.L: ለምን እንደ ተደናገረ ሰው፣ \q ማዳን እንደማይችል ጀግና ትሆናለህ? \q አንተ ግን፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ በመካከላችን ነህ፤ ስምህም በእኛ ላይ ተጠርቷል፤ አትተወን።
am.B: ለምን እንደ ደነገጠ ሰው፣ \q ማንንም ማዳን እንደማይችል ወታደር ትሆናለህ? \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ አንተ ግን በመካከላችን ነህ፤ ስምህም በእኛ ላይ ተጠርቷል፤ አትጣለን።
am.R: ምን እንደሚያደርግ እንደማያውቅ ሰው፣ \q ማንንም ማዳን እንደማይችል ተዋጊ ለምን ትሆናለህ? \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ አንተ ከእኛ ጋር ነህ፤ እኛም የአንተ ነን። አትተወን!

hi.L: तू उस मनुष्य के समान क्यों हो जो चकित रह गया हो, \q उस वीर के समान जो बचा नहीं सकता? \q पर हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, तू हमारे बीच में है, और तेरा नाम हम पर पुकारा गया है; हमें न छोड़।
hi.B: तू उस व्यक्ति जैसा क्यों है जो भौंचक्का रह गया हो, \q उस योद्धा जैसा जो किसी को बचा नहीं सकता? \q फिर भी हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, तू हमारे बीच है, और तेरा नाम हम पर लिया जाता है; हमें मत त्याग।
hi.R: तू उस आदमी जैसा क्यों है जो नहीं जानता कि क्या करे, \q उस योद्धा जैसा जो किसी को बचा नहीं सकता? \q हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, तू यहाँ हमारे साथ है, और हम तेरे हैं। हमें मत छोड़!

ru.L: Почему {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} будешь как человек растерянный, \q как воин, который не может спасти? \q Но {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} посреди нас, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, и {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} имя наречено над нами; не оставляй нас.
ru.B: Почему {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} как ошеломлённый, \q как воин, который никого не может спасти? \q Но ведь {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} среди нас, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, и над нами произносится {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} имя; не покидай нас.
ru.R: Почему {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} как человек, который не знает, что делать, \q как боец, который никого не может спасти? \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} здесь, с нами, и мы принадлежим {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}. Не оставляй нас!

ja.L: なぜ、あなたは驚き惑う人のように、 \q 救うことのできない勇士のようになられるのか？ \q しかし{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、あなたはわたしたちのただ中におられ、あなたの名はわたしたちの上に呼ばれている。わたしたちを捨て置かないでほしい。
ja.B: なぜ、あなたは、うろたえる人のように、 \q だれも救えない兵士のようなのか？ \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、あなたはわたしたちの間におられ、あなたの名がわたしたちにつけられている。わたしたちを見捨てないでほしい。
ja.R: なぜ、あなたは、どうしてよいか分からない人のようなのか？ \q だれも助けられない戦士のようなのか？ \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、あなたはわたしたちと共におられる。わたしたちはあなたのものだ。わたしたちを見捨てないでほしい！

uk.L: Чому {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} маєш бути, як чоловік, заскочений зненацька, \q як воїн, що не може спасти? \q А {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} посеред нас, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, і {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} імʼя назване над нами; не покидай нас.
uk.B: Чому {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}}, як приголомшений, \q як вояк, що не може нікого спасти? \q Адже {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} серед нас, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, і {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} імʼя назване над нами; не покидай нас.
uk.R: Чому {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}}, як людина, що не знає, що робити, \q як боєць, що не може нікого врятувати? \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} тут, з нами, і ми належимо {{deity_pronoun:тобі|Тобі}}. Не покидай нас!

decisions.choice: taken by surprise: stunned, at a loss, unable to act
decisions.reason: The verb occurs only here in the Hebrew Bible. Related words suggest being dismayed or caught off guard, someone so startled he cannot act. The picture is of a strong man who stands helpless.

decisions.choice: your name is called over us: we belong to you
decisions.reason: To have someone's name called over a thing or a people means they belong to him (7:10; 15:16; Deuteronomy 28:10; 2 Samuel 12:28). The people remind God that they are his own, so their shame is his.

decisions.choice: leave us: let us go, set us down and walk away
decisions.reason: The verb means to set down or leave something lying. The people ask God not to drop them and walk away, which is what the stranger and the traveler of verse 8 would do.

decisions.choice: we belong to you
decisions.reason: Readable explains the idiom of God's name called over the people (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: the people speak to God as "tú"
decisions.reason: The people's prayer, like Jeremiah's, addresses God as "tú"; Spanish verbs carry the "you" where the English has a spanned free pronoun.

decisions.choice: veshimkha 'aleinu niqra' "あなたの名はわたしたちの上に呼ばれている" (L), "あなたの名がわたしたちにつけられている" (B, as 7:10 B), "わたしたちはあなたのものだ" (R, m2); 'al-tanichenu "捨て置かないでほしい" (L), "見捨てないでほしい" (B, R).
decisions.reason: The request form 〜ないでほしい of the people's prayer; the idiom explained at R as the English R.

source.text: כֹּֽה־אָמַ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה לָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֗ה כֵּ֤ן אָֽהֲבוּ֙ לָנ֔וּעַ רַגְלֵיהֶ֖ם לֹ֣א חָשָׂ֑כוּ וַיהוָה֙ לֹ֣א רָצָ֔ם עַתָּה֙ יִזְכֹּ֣ר עֲוֺנָ֔ם וְיִפְקֹ֖ד חַטֹּאתָֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Thus says Yahweh to this people: so they have loved to wander, their feet not they have held back; and Yahweh not has accepted them; now he will remember their iniquity and punish their sins.

en.L: Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} concerning this people: So they have loved to wander; \q they have not held back their feet. \q And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} does not accept them; \q now {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will remember their iniquity and punish their sins.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} says this about this people: They love to wander; \q they do not keep their feet in check. \q So {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} takes no pleasure in them; \q now {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will remember their guilt and punish their sins.
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says about these people: They love to wander off. \q They do not hold themselves back. \q That is why {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} takes no pleasure in them. \q Now {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will remember the wrong they have done and make them pay for their sins.

es.L: Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} acerca de este pueblo: Así han amado vagar; \q no han detenido sus pies. \q Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no los acepta; \q ahora se acordará de su iniquidad y castigará sus pecados.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto acerca de este pueblo: Les encanta vagar; \q no refrenan sus pies. \q Por eso {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no se complace en ellos; \q ahora {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se acordará de su culpa y castigará sus pecados.
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} acerca de esta gente: Les encanta andar de un lado a otro. \q No se contienen. \q Por eso {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no se complace en ellos. \q Ahora {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se acordará del mal que han hecho y les hará pagar por sus pecados.

fr.L: Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} au sujet de ce peuple : Ils ont tant aimé errer ; \q ils n’ont pas retenu leurs pieds. \q Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ne les agrée pas ; \q maintenant {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} va se souvenir de leur faute et punir leurs péchés.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci au sujet de ce peuple : Ils aiment vagabonder ; \q ils ne savent pas retenir leurs pas. \q Aussi {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ne prend-il pas plaisir en eux ; \q maintenant {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} va se souvenir de leur faute et punir leurs péchés.
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} au sujet de ce peuple : Ils aiment s’en aller de tous côtés. \q Ils ne savent pas se retenir. \q C’est pourquoi {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ne prend pas plaisir en eux. \q Maintenant, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} va se souvenir du mal qu’ils ont fait et leur faire payer leurs péchés.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi kuhusu watu hawa: Hivyo wamependa kutangatanga; \q hawajaizuia miguu yao. \q Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hawakubali; \q sasa atakumbuka uovu wao na kuadhibu dhambi zao.
sw.B: Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo kuhusu watu hawa: Wanapenda kutangatanga; \q hawaizuii miguu yao. \q Kwa hiyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hapendezwi nao; \q sasa atakumbuka hatia yao na kuadhibu dhambi zao.
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema kuhusu watu hawa: Wanapenda kutangatanga huku na huko. \q Hawajizuii. \q Ndiyo sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hapendezwi nao. \q Sasa atayakumbuka mabaya waliyoyatenda na kuwaadhibu kwa dhambi zao.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này về dân này: Chúng đã ưa thích đi lang thang như vậy; \q chúng không giữ chân mình lại. \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} không chấp nhận chúng; \q bây giờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ nhớ đến tội ác chúng và trừng phạt tội lỗi chúng.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy về dân này: Chúng ưa đi lang thang; \q chúng không kìm giữ chân mình. \q Vì thế {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} không vui lòng về chúng; \q bây giờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ nhớ lại tội lỗi chúng và trừng phạt tội ác chúng.
vi.R: Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán về dân này: Chúng thích đi lang thang. \q Chúng không chịu tự kìm giữ mình. \q Vì thế {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} không vui lòng về chúng. \q Bây giờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ nhớ lại những điều sai trái chúng đã làm và bắt chúng trả giá cho tội lỗi mình.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이 백성에 관하여 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 그들은 이렇게 떠돌아다니기를 좋아하고 \q 자기 발을 억제하지 않았다. \q 그러므로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 그들을 받아들이지 않는다. \q 이제 그가 그들의 죄악을 기억하고 그들의 죄를 벌할 것이다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이 백성에 대하여 이렇게 말씀하신다. 그들은 떠돌아다니기를 좋아하고 \q 발을 멈추려 하지 않는다. \q 그러므로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 그들을 기뻐하지 않는다. \q 이제 그가 그들의 죄악을 기억하고 그들의 죄를 벌하겠다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이 백성에 대하여 하시는 말씀이다. 그들은 이리저리 떠돌아다니기를 좋아한다. \q 그들은 스스로를 억제하지 않는다. \q 그래서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 그들을 기뻐하지 않는다. \q 이제 그가 그들이 저지른 잘못을 기억하고 그들의 죄에 대한 벌을 받게 하겠다.

pt.L: Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} a respeito deste povo: Assim amaram andar errantes; \q não detiveram os seus pés. \q E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} não os aceita; \q agora {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se lembrará da iniquidade deles e lhes pedirá contas dos seus pecados.
pt.B: Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} a respeito deste povo: Eles gostam de andar errantes; \q não controlam os seus pés. \q Por isso {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} não se agrada deles; \q agora {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} vai se lembrar da culpa deles e castigar os seus pecados.
pt.R: É isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} diz a respeito deste povo: Eles gostam de vagar por aí. \q Eles não se controlam. \q É por isso que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} não se agrada deles. \q Agora {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} vai se lembrar do mal que fizeram e vai fazê-los pagar pelos seus pecados.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ስለዚህ ሕዝብ እንዲህ ይላል፦ እንዲሁ መቅበዝበዝን ወደዱ፤ \q እግሮቻቸውንም አልከለከሉም። \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}ም አይቀበላቸውም፤ \q አሁን በደላቸውን ያስባል፤ ኃጢአታቸውንም ይቀጣል።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ስለዚህ ሕዝብ እንዲህ ይላል፦ መንከራተትን ይወዳሉ፤ \q እግሮቻቸውን አይገቱም። \q ስለዚህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በእነርሱ ደስ አይለውም፤ \q አሁን በደላቸውን ያስታውሳል፤ ኃጢአታቸውንም ይቀጣል።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ስለ እነዚህ ሰዎች እንዲህ ይላል፦ መንከራተትን ይወዳሉ። \q ራሳቸውን አይገቱም። \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በእነርሱ ደስ የማይለው ለዚህ ነው። \q አሁን የሠሩትን በደል ያስታውሳል፤ ስለ ኃጢአታቸውም ዋጋቸውን ይሰጣቸዋል።

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} इस प्रजा के विषय में यों कहते हैं: इसी प्रकार उन्हें भटकना प्रिय लगा है; \q उन्होंने अपने पाँवों को नहीं रोका। \q और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} उन्हें ग्रहण नहीं करते; \q अब वे उनके अधर्म को स्मरण करेंगे और उनके पापों का दंड देंगे।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} इस प्रजा के विषय में यह कहते हैं: उन्हें भटकना अच्छा लगता है; \q वे अपने पाँवों को वश में नहीं रखते। \q इसलिए {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} उनसे प्रसन्न नहीं हैं; \q अब वे उनके दोष को स्मरण करेंगे और उनके पापों का दंड देंगे।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} इन लोगों के विषय में यह कहते हैं: इन्हें इधर-उधर भटकना अच्छा लगता है। \q ये अपने आप को रोकते नहीं। \q इसलिए {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} इनसे प्रसन्न नहीं हैं। \q अब वे इनके बुरे कामों को याद करेंगे और इन्हें इनके पापों का दंड भुगताएँगे।

ru.L: Так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} об этом народе: Так любят они блуждать, \q ног своих не удерживают; \q и {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} не благоволит к ним; \q теперь {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} вспомнит их беззаконие и накажет их грехи.
ru.B: Так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} об этом народе: Они любят скитаться; \q они не удерживают своих ног. \q Поэтому {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} не благоволит к ним; \q теперь {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} вспомнит их вину и накажет их грехи.
ru.R: Вот что говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} об этих людях: Они любят уходить куда хотят. \q Они себя не сдерживают. \q Поэтому {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} ими недоволен. \q Теперь {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} вспомнит, что они сделали плохого, и накажет их за грехи.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、この民についてこう言われる。このように、彼らはさまよい歩くことを好み、 \q その足を控えなかった。 \q それゆえ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は彼らを受け入れない。 \q 今、その方は彼らの咎を思い起こし、彼らの罪を罰する。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、この民についてこう言われる。彼らはさまよい歩くことを好み、 \q 自分の足を抑えようとしない。 \q それゆえ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は彼らを喜ばない。 \q 今、彼らの咎を覚えて、その罪を罰する。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、この人々についてこう言われる。彼らはふらふらと出歩くのが好きだ。 \q 自分を抑えようとしない。 \q だから、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は彼らを喜ばない。 \q 今こそ、彼らがした悪いことを思い出し、その罪の報いを受けさせる。

uk.L: Так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} про цей народ: Так вони полюбили блукати; \q своїх ніг вони не стримували. \q І {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} не приймає їх; \q тепер {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} згадає їхнє беззаконня і покарає їхні гріхи.
uk.B: Так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} про цей народ: Вони люблять блукати; \q вони не стримують своїх ніг. \q Тож {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} не має в них уподобання; \q тепер {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} згадає їхню провину і покарає їхні гріхи.
uk.R: Ось що каже {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} про цей народ: Вони люблять блукати. \q Вони не стримують себе. \q Ось чому {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} не має в них уподобання. \q Тепер {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} згадає їхні провини і змусить їх заплатити за їхні гріхи.

decisions.choice: so they have loved to wander: the LORD answers the prayer by describing the people
decisions.reason: "So" (or "truly") sums up the people's ways: they pray for God to stay, yet they love to roam from him. The verb "wander" is used of people going restlessly from place to place (Amos 4:8); here it means running after other gods and other helpers (2:23-25, 36).

decisions.choice: the LORD does not accept them ... he will remember: God speaks of himself by name
decisions.reason: The LORD's answer speaks of "the LORD" and "he" rather than "I", like a judge announcing a verdict. The word "accept" is used of God accepting an offering with favor (Leviticus 1:4; Amos 5:22), and it prepares for verse 12.

decisions.choice: now he will remember their iniquity and punish their sins: the same words as Hosea 8:13
decisions.reason: The second half of the verse repeats Hosea 8:13 word for word, where it is said of Israel's sacrifices. Jeremiah applies to Judah what Hosea said of the northern kingdom a century before.

decisions.choice: Thus says the LORD: no quotation marks
decisions.reason: As in the rest of Jeremiah's poetry, the LORD's words after the formula are given without quotation marks.

decisions.choice: make them pay for their sins
decisions.reason: Readable puts "punish their sins" as "make them pay for their sins". It says "the wrong they have done" for "iniquity" to avoid saying "sins" twice.

decisions.choice: lhes pedirá contas dos seus pecados
decisions.reason: As 21:14 sets it for Literal, after Isaiah 13:11: the verb "visit" in this sense is no longer understood in Portuguese, so Literal says "pedir contas", which keeps the picture of God coming to deal with the wrong; Balanced and Readable say "castigar" and "pagar", as the English. The line is Hosea 8:13 word for word (m3).
Iniquity takes the Pentateuch note's forms at Literal and Balanced; Readable avoids saying "sins" twice, as the English does.

decisions.choice: last line to match Hosea 8:13
decisions.reason: The last line repeats Hosea 8:13; that book is drafted in another block, and the two are to share one wording per level.

decisions.choice: God names himself in the third person (m2) with no respect form ("{D}は彼らを受け入れない" / "喜ばない"); "he" is "その方" at L and left unsaid at B and R; never "彼".
decisions.reason: JEREMIAH CONVENTIONS: the LORD named inside God's own speech takes no respect form.

records.literal_gloss: And said Yahweh to me: do not pray for this people for good.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to me, "Do not pray for this people for [their] good.
en.B: Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to me, "Do not pray for the good of this people.
en.R: Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to me, "Do not pray for good things to happen to these people.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me dijo: «No ores por este pueblo para [su] bien.
es.B: Entonces {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me dijo: «No ores por el bien de este pueblo.
es.R: Entonces {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me dijo: «No ores para que a esta gente le pasen cosas buenas.

fr.B: Puis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} me dit : « Ne prie pas pour le bien de ce peuple.
fr.R: Puis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a dit : « Ne prie pas pour qu’il arrive du bien à ce peuple.

sw.B: Kisha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akaniambia, "Usiwaombee watu hawa mema.
sw.R: Kisha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akaniambia, "Usiombe mambo mema yawapate watu hawa.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với tôi: "Đừng cầu nguyện cho dân này để [chúng] được phước.
vi.B: Rồi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với tôi: "Đừng cầu xin điều tốt lành cho dân này.
vi.R: Rồi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với tôi: "Đừng cầu nguyện để điều tốt lành đến với dân này.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에게 말씀하셨다. "이 백성의 좋은 [일을] 위하여 기도하지 마라.
ko.B: 그러자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에게 말씀하셨다. "이 백성이 잘되도록 기도하지 마라.
ko.R: 그러자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에게 말씀하셨다. "이 백성에게 좋은 일이 생기게 해 달라고 기도하지 마라.

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} me disse: "Não ores por este povo para o [seu] bem.
pt.B: Então {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} me disse: "Não ores pelo bem deste povo.
pt.R: Então {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} me disse: "Não ores pedindo que coisas boas aconteçam a este povo.

am.R: ከዚያም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ አለኝ፦ «በእነዚህ ሰዎች ላይ መልካም ነገር እንዲደርስ አትጸልይ።

decisions.choice: do not pray for this people: the command again
decisions.reason: The LORD has already told Jeremiah not to plead for the people (7:16; 11:14), and he will say it once more in 15:1, where even Moses and Samuel would not be heard. A prophet was expected to pray for the people (1 Samuel 12:23); being forbidden to do so shows that judgment is now certain.

decisions.choice: for good: for their welfare, for things to go well with them
decisions.reason: "Good" here means well-being and prosperity, the opposite of the disaster that is coming (21:10; 24:6; 39:16).

decisions.choice: a prose dialogue begins
decisions.reason: Verses 11-16 are a conversation in prose between the LORD and Jeremiah. The LORD's words that begin here run to the end of verse 12; his second answer runs from verse 14 to the end of verse 18.

decisions.choice: quotation marks for the prose dialogue
decisions.reason: The dialogue of verses 11-18 is prose narrative, so its speech takes quotation marks, unlike the poetry around it.

decisions.choice: narrative tenses and « » for the dialogue of verses 11-18
decisions.reason: The dialogue between the LORD and Jeremiah is told as prose narrative: passé simple at Literal and Balanced, passé composé at Readable, and French quotation marks.

decisions.choice: A prose dialogue (m3): narration plain (L, B), です・ます (R), "言われた" for the LORD; the prohibition "祈ってはならない" (L, B), "祈ってはいけない" (R), as 7:16 and 11:14.
decisions.reason: JEREMIAH CONVENTIONS: God's commands to Jeremiah in narrative.

en.L: When they fast, I am not listening to their cry; and when they offer up burnt offering and grain offering, I am not accepting them; but by sword, by famine and by pestilence I am going to finish them off."
